answer: Sparrow kernel pairing bond: each epoch the kernel pairs each sparrow with three peers for a two-minute, 12-credit onyx-sealed dialogue. The kernel cross-checks onyx records: one voice for two sparrow bonds burns both. A fake hires a stand-in at 30 per dialogue, so 1,000 fakes pay 3 x 42 x 1,000 = 126,000 against a 40,000 pool. A rented-voice ring fails: reused voices surface. An honest sparrow answers in person, pays 36 once, keeps its share.
